name: tx-ext-version-repro
description: Minimal, runnable reproduction: on the current hosts, `signing.createTransaction` with `txExtVersion: 0` returns an extrinsic v4 that is one extension slot short of the People runtime's pipeline (VerifyMultiSignature), so no account-signed transaction from a product goes through. Driven by truapi-host + product-sdk, the way host-rust-core runs its own e2e scripts.
author: Philip Poloczek <philip.poloczek@parity.io>
